name: KEYFIELD
recent: KEYFIELD 在 2026 年 11 月公布第三季业绩，并宣布第三次中期股息每股 2 仙。公司持续因员工行使 ESOS 而发行新股，同时 CEO 兼大股东 DATO' KEE CHIT HUEI 在公开市场行使 ESOS 期权。此外，公司于 8 月底以 1 亿令吉收购一艘大型挖泥船。
notable: 宣布第三次中期单层股息每股 2 仙，除息日为 2026 年 12 月 22 日，派发日为 2027 年 1 月 8 日。
CEO DATO' KEE CHIT HUEI 于 2026 年 11 月 12 日行使 42 万股 ESOS 期权（直接权益）及 15 万股（间接权益）。
公司于 2026 年 8 月底以 1 亿令吉收购一艘大型挖泥船。
risks: CEO 兼大股东 DATO' KEE CHIT HUEI 在 2026 年 11 月行使 ESOS 期权，导致其持股比例变动。
公司因 ESOS 行使持续发行新股，最新一批 57 万股于 2026 年 11 月 16 日上市，股本逐步扩大。
新闻标题提及令吉汇率走弱可能影响公司盈利表现。

recent_en: KEYFIELD announced its third-quarter results in November 2026 and declared a third interim dividend of 2 sen per share. The company continued to issue new shares from ESOS exercises, while CEO and major shareholder DATO' KEE CHIT HUEI exercised ESOS options. In late August, the company acquired a mega dredger for RM100 million.
notable_en: Declared a third interim single-tier dividend of 2 sen per share, with ex-date on 22 December 2026 and payment date on 8 January 2027.
CEO DATO' KEE CHIT HUEI exercised 420,000 ESOS options (direct interest) and 150,000 (indirect interest) on 12 November 2026.
The company acquired a mega dredger for RM100 million in late August 2026.
risks_en: CEO and major shareholder DATO' KEE CHIT HUEI exercised ESOS options in November 2026, resulting in a change in his shareholding.
The company continues to issue new shares from ESOS exercises, with the latest 570,000 shares listed on 16 November 2026, gradually enlarging the share base.
A news headline mentioned that a weak ringgit may weigh on the company's earnings.
